SITE VISIT:   The site visit is scheduled for 11/12/2026. All 
interested parties must submit their security information for access to 
Michael Rossini Michael.j.rossini3.civ@us.navy.mil prior to 11/10/2026. 
Please include your name and phone number. Please have a valid ID for 
access to the base. For questions, please contact Danielle Russo 
at danielle.m.russo4.civ@us.navy.mil 
  

   NOTE:   All parties interested in bidding on the proposal must attend the 
site visit. Bids submitted from parties that did not attend the site visit will 
not be considered. 
  

 
	 Description of Requirement 
	This procurement is for a hoist and conductor bar upgrade on an existing 
	bridge crane in support of the Prototype, Manufacturing, and Test Division 
	(PMTD). Please see the attached SOW for the following: 
 

  
• Requirement Details and Specifications 
• Inspection and Acceptance 
• Packaging, Preservation and Shipping 
  

 The resultant contract will be a firm-fixed-price contract. 
  

 II. Solicitation Instructions. (i) This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for 
commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in Federal 
Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Subpart 12.6, as supplemented with 
additional information included in this notice. This announcement 
constitutes the only solicitation; quotes are being requested and a written 
solicitation will not be issued. (ii) This solicitation is issued as a Request for 
Quote (RFQ) in accordance with FAR Part 12 & FAR Subpart 13.5 under 
solicitation number N68335-27-Q-1037 (iii) The solicitation documents 
and incorporated provisions and clauses are those in effect through 
Federal Acquisition Circular 2024-01. (iv) This will be Small Business Set- 
Aside. The associated North American Industrial Classification System 
(NAICS) code for this procurement is 811310 with a size standard of $12.5 Million. 

 The Product Service Code is K039. (v) See attached 
Statement of Work (SOW), Contract Data Requirements List (CDRL), Crane Alteration Request, and 
Photos for requirement specifications. (vi) The description of the 
requirements for the items to be acquired are provided in the description 
above and the attached SOW. (vii) See attached SOW for Date(s) and 
place(s) of delivery and acceptance. FOB point is destination. Any 
applicable shipping costs shall be factored into the unit price(s) of each 
item. Do not include a separate line item for shipping charges. (viii) FAR 
52.212-1 Instructions to Offerors--Commercial Products and Commercial 
Services, is incorporated. (ix) FAR 52.212-2, Evaluation-Commercial 
Products and Commercial Services is incorporated. (x) This solicitation is 
open to small businesses. 
  

 (a) The Government will award a contract resulting from this solicitation to 
the responsible offeror whose offer conforming to the solicitation will be 
most advantageous to the Government, price and other factors 
considered. The following factors shall be used to evaluate offers: 
  

 Award shall be made to the offeror whose quotation is deemed technically 
acceptable and is lowest price. The Government will evaluate quotations 
based on the following evaluation criteria: 1) Technical Description; 2) 
Price; 3) Capabilities Statement 

 
	 Technical Description: The Government will evaluate whether the quoter 
	has included a technical description of the items being offered in sufficient 
	detail to evaluate compliance with the requirements in the solicitation, 
	including the attached SOW. Quotations that do not include a technical 
	description of the items being offered or do not include a technical 
	description of the items being offered in sufficient detail to evaluation 
	compliance with the requirements in the solicitation, including the 
	attached SOW will not be considered for award. 
	 Price: The Government will evaluate price for reasonableness. 
 

 (x) Offerors shall submit a capabilities statement that summarizes their capacity to execute this requirement. Their capability statement shall include instances in which the offeror demonstrates that they have successfully completed substantial elements similar to the requirements of the statement of work (SOW) (Attachment 0001). This may include, but is not limited to: Government contract actions directly related to the offerors capabilities to satisfy the requirements outlined in Attachment 0001, other than Government contract actions directly related to the offerors capabilities to satisfy the requirements outlined in Attachment 0001. Capabilities statements shall be no longer than three (3) pages. Offerors whose capabilities statements do not sufficiently demonstrate the offeror’s ability to successfully complete substantial elements similar to the requirements of the statement of work will not be considered for award. 

 As of November 2025, it became a requirement for vendors to self-report their Cyber Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) level in accordance with clauses 252.204-7012 and 252.204-7020. No new awards can be made without adherence to the proper CMMC level. The options are Level 1 through Level 4. 

 The required CMMC level for this requirement is Level 1 Self Assessment . CMMC certification must be completed before any award that may result from this solicitation will take place.
